description: Use this tool for DIGESTED legislative history — per-article intent summaries and key arguments, not verbatim text. COVERAGE IS NARROW: BV and BGFA digests (167 articles) plus BV debate transcripts, and nothing else. For any other law this returns 0 hits, which means 'outside this index', not 'no materials exist'. Prefer search_botschaft, which covers all 6,154 Federal Council messages verbatim, or get_materialien(law_code) for the messages linked to one statute.

query.description: Search query (natural language or FTS5 syntax).
